Rack closed backup admission continuation — NEW source only

The nine new root checks pass on existing PGlite PostgreSQL18.6. This portable
path adaptation is supplied for NEW native PostgreSQL17 review of this installer,
not a request to rerun the previous29-test package or its already-passed native
concurrency tests. Reuse prior cfbc7d20 evidence for that unchanged work.

No provider credentials, runtime envelopes, token IDs or values, reviewer keys,
real auth sessions, customer records, provider logs or managed catalogue snapshots
are included. fixture-pin.json is an explicitly synthetic local test input, NOT
managed-project evidence or authority. Fixed source/project/bucket/account scope
fences are non-secret constants. Tests create only disposable local databases.

The existing reviewed dispatch and ticket SQL are frozen INPUTS matching the
closed installation performed by root. Four proposed service-role grants are
removed by the wrapper; all new objects are empty/owner-only. The wrapper adds
exact target/event/legacy fingerprints, preserved old objects and effective ACL
checks including inherited MAINTAIN. It never seeds, grants, schedules or writes
archives. Root's managed PG17 atomic installation succeeded; all new runtime
role permissions, including MAINTAIN, were independently read back false.

Important current-source comparison: the included ticket input is the root's
older reviewed local source (SHA097aea882ec2c2a7f8109aba4c6d4b46105635cda44d88f4ddc7b357155021b5).
Your previously completed cfbc7d20 update adds the inherited MAINTAIN check and
two schedule-ticket adapter validation fixes. Do not redo that work. Compare
current installed bundle provenance with that canonical follow-up and prepare
only the missing parity delta; do not claim deployed parity from code tests.

Cloud scope: source engineering/review, new disposable native tests, a precise
remaining hosted-backup/coherent-restore packet and no provider/account change.
Do not deploy, install managed SQL, create/refresh/export credentials, sign in,
send mail, enable a schedule, seed tickets, write R2, change live settings/payments,
buy services or use CCP/Allegiant systems. Root retains operational control.
No stage in this carrier is automatic-capture/full-restore acceptance.
